heldReason: The dictionary closes 氐 with a long horizontal bar while the pinned MM candidate writes a short dot; a bar cannot be derived from the dot's own points without inventing extent, so the glyph fails closed. The Ja corpus keeps the bar form (祗 in this batch).

directionProbe.threshold: angle over 60° between dictionary and candidate start-to-end vectors

subThresholdSlants.note: Short dots the dictionary draws vertically while the licensed corpora slant them, below the inspection threshold. Kept as licensed geometry, as in batches 1 to 12.

sourceTransform.note: serve.py, source-checks.mjs and direction-probe.mjs accept translate(x, -y); no glyph in this batch uses a horizontal offset.
